d: AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. The business operates at the intersection of premium brand building, investment storytelling, and exceptional customer experience, with a focus on creating a distinctive global presence in the luxury real estate sector.

This role is an opportunity to lead the digital marketing strategy and strengthen AHS's position as a leading ultra-luxury real estate brand. As Digital Marketing Director, you will oversee the digital ecosystem, drive high-impact campaigns, enhance brand visibility, and develop innovative strategies to engage high-net-worth individuals and international investors. Working closely with executive leadership, sales, and marketing teams, you will ensure digital initiatives translate into measurable business growth, qualified leads, and exceptional brand experiences.
q: 8+ years of digital marketing experience, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership or director-level position.
A degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
Proven experience within luxury real estate development, premium property brands, or high-end hospitality and lifestyle sectors, with luxury real estate developer experience highly preferred.
Strong track record of developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies for premium brands.
Extensive knowledge of paid media, performance marketing, SEO, SEM, social media, content marketing, and marketing automation.
Demonstrated experience managing substantial digital marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROI and lead generation results.
Strong understanding of marketing to ultra-high-net-worth individuals, international investors, and affluent audiences.
Experience with off-plan property launches, branded residences, luxury property campaigns, and international market positioning.
Proficiency in digital analytics and reporting tools, including Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and CRM or marketing automation platforms.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary digital marketing teams and manage external agencies and strategic partnerships.
Strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate business objectives into effective digital strategies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present strategies and performance insights to C-suite executives and senior leadership.
